propositions: Under pytest-xdist with -n 3 --dist worksteal, each worker's process-local lru_cache on _rendered() independently re-renders all 178 corpus bodies (~884 pandoc spawns each), triplicating CPU work for an identical immutable artifact.
The three test_dc_corpus_passes_two_to_five_are_byte_identical parametrizations each recompute render_markdown_to_wiki pass 1, duplicating work already cached by _rendered() in the consumer tests.

A session-scoped, digest-keyed cross-worker artifact stored on disk and sharded per stratum, protected by inter-process locks, reduces the corpus fill from one per worker to one per session without new dependencies or post-session artifacts.
Strata are probed in PYTEST_XDIST_WORKER-rotated order to prevent concurrent consumers from queueing on the same shard, reducing cold-session wall time from ~42s per fill to ~17s for one stratum.
A 150s fallback deadline allows blocked workers to render locally and still finish under the 300s timeout, degrading gracefully to per-worker behavior on lock timeout rather than deadlocking.

The artifact digest embeds SHA-256 of corpus JSON files, wiki_render module source, and pandoc version+path+size, so any corpus or renderer edit invalidates stale renders and forces a fresh computation.
